      "target": "伊格兰斯是一个强烈反对魔法的古老组织。其中一些人与自然高度契合，甚至能仅凭自身意志抵抗奥术力量。"

      "notes": "Lite review batch 0182 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/init.lua",
      "source": "The Nargol empire was once the largest force in Maj'Eyal, but a combination of the Spellblaze and orcish attacks have dwindled it into insignificance.",
      "source_tag": "init.lua load_tips",
      "special": null,
      "target": "纳格尔帝国曾经是马基·埃亚尔最强大的势力，但魔法大爆炸和兽人的进攻使其日渐衰落，变得无足轻重。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "806e704bc8b3373c7d6368cf474039c23ef603dc918eb2ca219d6149dbb06a68",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0182 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/init.lua",
      "source": "Dwarves are naturally a inquisitive people, but do not enjoy such inquisition turned on them. Most live secretive lives in their closed-off city, the Iron Throne.",
      "source_tag": "init.lua load_tips",
      "special": null,
      "target": "矮人天性好奇，却不喜欢别人反过来探究他们。大多数矮人在封闭的城市——钢铁王座中，过着隐秘的生活。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "6df7c2372947c239607cd92c0b1782cd461950eecda300bde5024c75db795630",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0182 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/init.lua",
      "source": "The art of potion making fell into decline after the Spellhunt, and only a rare few now master the gift.",
      "source_tag": "init.lua load_tips",
      "special": null,
      "target": "猎魔行动之后，药水制作技艺逐渐衰落，如今只有极少数人掌握这门技艺。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "a32d57dd7b29014939db32948a58847f49e19a01a8b8cc71533366ea46a1c5a5",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0182 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/init.lua",
      "source": "Maj'Eyal is the biggest continent in the world of Eyal. Though records suggest other continents and islands may exist it has not been possible to cross the wide and stormy oceans since the Spellblaze and the Cataclysm.",
      "source_tag": "init.lua load_tips",
      "special": null,
      "target": "马基·埃亚尔是埃亚尔世界中最大的一块大陆。虽然记载表明可能还存在其他大陆和岛屿，但自魔法大爆炸和大灾变以来，人们一直无法横渡浩瀚而风暴肆虐的海洋。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "9c11d2e9381efba957ac34ac904b43a79b05751696a1ece9becd46c61cb36291",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0182 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/init.lua",
      "source": "The highest sorcerers are known as archmages, and the masters amongst them are said to have the power to change the world. They are feared immensely.",
      "source_tag": "init.lua load_tips",
      "special": null,
      "target": "元素法师被认为是最高级别的法师，据说其中的大师拥有改变世界的力量。他们令世人极为畏惧。"
    }
  ],
